title: Decide every odd-order character rank cut before bit-word search
body:
## Summary

Add `research/bit-odd-character-screen/`, a complete finite decision procedure for all odd-order cyclic character counting rank cuts in the formal abelian bit model. There is no character-order cutoff.

```text
paid zero subset
  quotient by its actual integer subgroup
    exact subgroup indices and target inclusion-exclusion
      necessary-screen pass or rational rejection certificate
```

The written avoidance lemma handles both finite torsion and free quotient directions. Rejections exclude every call order and any finite restored dirty workspace under the stated full formal endpoint contract. Passing establishes only these necessary cuts.

This closes one pre-search implication in [Discussion2898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2898#discussioncomment-18975523), not a new register construction or supplier. The task records its scope change and decision not to expand a construction family.

## Evidence

- Before, even every prime-order counting cut can miss an obstruction. Paid labels `(15,1)` and targets `(6,10)` pass all prime-order cuts and determinant equality.
- After, the complete screen rejects that control with exact order-15 avoidance density `8/15`. It also passes the direct nine-call fixture and recovers PR2949's one-paid/three-target ternary cut with density `2/3`.
- Registered replay passes all eight behavioral groups, including 784 independent direct-character comparisons, 476 exact finite-quotient density comparisons, 144 Leibniz determinant checks and four executable implementation mutants. All 144 research-workflow tests pass.
- Normal CPython 3.12.15 and optimized CPython 3.13.5 pass on Linux x86_64. Ruff, extended correctness diagnostics, warning-as-error compilation and committed-byte preflight pass.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-odd-character-screen
```

Exact contribution head: `466c65e73b3efb5f8144799792fbef0acf4369cf`. Initial canonical main: `318ba71b8927f81141f41a89c1af74323586f253`. Final recorded refresh: `0614abaef427f123d9b844f85a759e64ee3ab29c`, priority revision 5. Archive intake changed neither relevant guidance, selected result, proof inputs nor applicable replay controls. Source hashes, commands and coverage limits are in the package metadata.

Credit the retained Ali Romman/eumemic/huxint projection lineage, Tuafo and mixed-target augmentation, the rational-cut checker, PR2938 and PR2949. No broader literature priority or independent human review is claimed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package and its opt-in replay registration.

No selected-frontier, frozen-source or shared-runtime edits. The CLI is bounded to address dimension three, nine paid frames and three targets. Rejection certifies character existence without emitting an explicit character. Dyadic/matrix-valued cuts, full formal words, native costs, hosting, precision and supplier admission remain outside scope. No new kappa, full selected cold replay, proof-assistant check or hosted CI pass is claimed.

The next useful step is one concrete unequal-class candidate passing the complete odd screen plus the existing rational, determinant and required dyadic screens, with a favorable complete native consumer budget before scalar search.
